name: btn-hover-multiple
title: Multi Shadow Hover Button
blurb: Multiple layered shadows appear on hover as button translates.
description: A button with multiple shadow layers stacked beneath it. On hover, the button and all shadows translate up and to the left, creating a cascading multi-shadow effect.
use_when: A playful CTA that should feel luxurious and three-dimensional.
avoid_when: Minimalist designs or when visual noise should be minimal.
a11y: Native button element with full keyboard support.
